title: Fix product upload/edit in admin panel and apply pink button styling site-wide

requirements.summary: Fix the 'Add Product' flow in ProductManagement so that submitting the add-product dialog successfully creates a new product and refreshes the list without errors
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Add Product' and submitting the form with valid data creates a new product in the backend.
The product list refreshes and shows the newly added product after submission.
No console errors or unhandled exceptions occur during the add-product flow.
Validation errors (empty required fields) are shown inline without crashing the form.

file_operations.description: Fix the add product dialog to ensure all required fields (title, category, price, mrp, discountPercentage, imageUrl, affiliateLink, isFeatured) are properly collected, validated, and submitted to the addProduct mutation. Ensure proper error handling for validation failures and backend errors. After successful submission, trigger a query invalidation to refresh the product list. Verify that the dialog closes and resets state after successful submission.

Review and fix the addProduct mutation hook to ensure it correctly maps the frontend product form data to the ProductInput type expected by the backend addProduct method. Ensure proper error handling and success callbacks that invalidate the 'products' query to trigger a list refresh. Verify the mutation returns the new product ID and that any error responses are surfaced to the UI.

requirements.summary: Fix the 'Edit Product' flow in ProductManagement so that opening a product in the edit dialog pre-populates all fields correctly, saves changes via updateProduct, and refreshes the list
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Edit' on any product opens the dialog with all existing fields (name, category, price, discount, featured flag, image URL, Amazon link) pre-filled.
Submitting the edit form updates the product in the backend.
The product list refreshes and reflects the updated product data after save.
No console errors or unhandled exceptions occur during the edit-product flow.

file_operations.description: Fix the edit product dialog to ensure all fields are correctly pre-populated from the selected product when the dialog opens. Map the Product type fields (title, category, price, mrp, discountPercentage, imageUrl, affiliateLink, isFeatured) into the form state. Ensure the dialog distinguishes between add and edit modes. On submission, call the updateProduct mutation with the product ID and updated ProductInput. Handle validation and backend errors gracefully. After successful update, invalidate the 'products' query to refresh the list and close the dialog.

Review and fix the updateProduct mutation hook to ensure it correctly accepts a product ID and ProductInput, maps the data to the backend updateProduct method signature, and handles success/error states properly. Ensure the mutation invalidates the 'products' query on success to trigger a list refresh. Verify error responses are surfaced to the UI component.

requirements.summary: Change every button across the entire frontend (public-facing pages and Admin Panel) to use the hot-pink color defined in the Tailwind config, ensuring consistency and removing any remaining non-pink primary button styles
acceptanceCriteria: All CTA and action buttons on the public-facing site render with the hot-pink background color.
All buttons inside the Admin Panel (login, register, add product, edit product, delete product, logout, tab navigation) render with the hot-pink background color.
No button retains a non-pink primary color (e.g., blue, gray, or default Tailwind primary).
Hover and focus states are visually consistent with a pink theme (e.g., darker pink on hover).
Destructive/danger buttons (e.g., delete) may use a red variant but all other action buttons must be pink.

file_operations.description: Update all CTA buttons in the Hero component to use the hot-pink Tailwind palette token (bg-hot-pink-600, hover:bg-hot-pink-700) instead of any blue or default primary colors. Ensure the text color provides sufficient contrast (text-white or text-hot-pink-50). Verify hover states use a darker pink shade.

Update any button elements in the Header component (if present) to use the hot-pink Tailwind palette token. Ensure navigation links that act as buttons (if styled as buttons) also use hot-pink background and hover states.

Update the newsletter signup submit button and any other action buttons in the Footer to use the hot-pink Tailwind palette token (bg-hot-pink-600, hover:bg-hot-pink-700). Ensure consistent button styling across the footer.

Update all CTA buttons (e.g., 'View on Amazon', pagination buttons, filter buttons) in the ProductGrid component to use the hot-pink Tailwind palette token. Replace any blue or default primary button classes with bg-hot-pink-600 and hover:bg-hot-pink-700. Ensure all action buttons have consistent pink styling.
If the SocialProof component contains any interactive buttons or CTAs, update them to use the hot-pink Tailwind palette token. Ensure consistency with the site-wide pink button theme.
If the TrustBadges component contains any interactive buttons or CTAs, update them to use the hot-pink Tailwind palette token. Ensure consistency with the site-wide pink button theme.

Update all buttons in the AdminLogin component (login submit, register submit, Internet Identity login, mode toggle) to use the hot-pink Tailwind palette token (bg-hot-pink-600, hover:bg-hot-pink-700). Replace any blue, gray, or default primary button classes with hot-pink. Ensure disabled states maintain a consistent pink theme (e.g., bg-hot-pink-400 with reduced opacity).

Update all buttons in the AdminPanel component (logout button, any action buttons in the top bar) to use the hot-pink Tailwind palette token. Update tab navigation buttons to use hot-pink for active/hover states. Ensure the logout button uses hot-pink styling consistent with the rest of the admin panel.

Update all buttons in the ProductManagement component (add product, edit product, save, cancel, delete) to use the hot-pink Tailwind palette token. Primary action buttons (add, save) should use bg-hot-pink-600 with hover:bg-hot-pink-700. Cancel buttons can use a neutral gray. Delete buttons may retain red styling for destructive actions. Ensure all dialog action buttons follow the pink theme.
